ideas.pitch: An augmented reality web app that overlays real-time 3D anatomical models and stress points onto physical mannequins or users via webcam computer vision.
ideas.problem_statement: Transforming healthcare education and training through immersive, real-world AR/VR/XR solutions.
ideas.title: AnatomyAR: Spatial Biomechanics for Medical Training
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a high-value domain (healthcare education) with a working computer vision pipeline that directly satisfies the hackathon's focus on practical real-world impact and AR/VR fundamentals.

ideas.pitch: A WebXR browser experience that transports users to side-by-side historical and projected 3D reconstructions of disappearing glaciers to drive climate awareness.
ideas.problem_statement: Exploring the potential of immersive technologies to transform education, tourism, and real-world environmental awareness.
ideas.title: EcoXR: Immersive Climate Data & Glacier Explorer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages WebXR for zero-install accessibility, combining high-polish 3D visuals with a compelling emotional narrative that resonates heavily with hackathon judges looking for real-world impact.

ideas.pitch: An AR movement-tracking game designed for physical therapy patients that turns monotonous rehabilitation exercises into an engaging spatial obstacle challenge.
ideas.problem_statement: Solving healthcare recovery compliance through innovative, immersive solutions and gamified real-world applications.
ideas.title: StepScribe: Immersive AR Rehabilitation Game
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on proven winning mechanics of fitness gamification while introducing clinical utility for physical therapy, making it a standout demo for judges.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight WebXR portal allowing users to walk through photogrammetry-scanned historical artifacts and lost cultural heritage sites directly in their browser.
ideas.problem_statement: Transforming tourism and education through XR by preserving and experiencing inaccessible cultural locations.
ideas.title: HeritageVessel: WebXR Historical Site Reconstruction
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on exceptional UX and a seamless live demo that works without expensive headset requirements, hitting the sweet spot of accessibility and technical polish.

ideas.pitch: A VR safety training environment built in Unity where industrial workers practice emergency response protocols in high-risk plant scenarios.
ideas.problem_statement: Transforming industry and workplace safety training using immersive virtual reality solutions.
ideas.title: SafeSite XR: Industrial Hazard Training Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a lucrative enterprise pain point (industrial safety compliance) with a rigorous simulation that showcases deep Unity engine proficiency.
